title: Ideation as an agent
description:
The daily monitor-stories plan runs at 07:30 UTC from a schedule in the monitoring template, and trend stories from the weekly knowledge run. Give ideation a definition with a schedule from data per site; keep plan-then-queue (the plan only plans; one message drafts one candidate) on the wake queue; keep the point check. Remove the fixed schedule from the template once every site's definition carries its own.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Each site's ideation time is site data.
- Ideas are filed once per candidate.
- The template no longer holds per-site idea schedules.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- ideation-agent.feature: the daily plan runs at the site's time; each candidate is drafted once; a draft that only restates its source is not filed; an empty day ends `nothing`.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Monitoring template: per-publication monitor-stories schedules removed after migration.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M2 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
